s:ibaraki/hitachi-seaside-park: Miharashi Hill at Hitachi Seaside Park in late April: a broad rounded hillside completely covered in sky-blue nemophila flowers, a narrow path winding to the top, small distant visitors, the blue Pacific Ocean on the horizon, bright clear spring sunshine.
s:ibaraki/kairakuen: Kairaku-en plum grove in early March: rows of old gnarled plum trees in full bloom with white, pale pink and deep pink blossoms over a grassy lawn, the dark wooden three-storey Kobuntei pavilion among bamboo in the background, soft spring sunshine.
s:ibaraki/fukuroda-falls: Fukuroda Falls in mid-November from the front observation deck: a wide waterfall cascading in four broad tiers over a tall dark rock face, white water spreading across the stepped cliff, steep slopes on both sides in red, orange and yellow foliage, soft overcast light.
s:ibaraki/mount-tsukuba: Mount Tsukuba from the rice fields of the Kanto Plain in early winter morning: the distinctive twin rocky peaks rising above a gentle forested slope, flat harvested paddies and a few farmhouses in the foreground, crisp clear air, pale blue sky.
s:ibaraki/oarai-isosaki: The Kamiiso torii at Oarai Isosaki Shrine at sunrise: a torii gate standing on dark volcanic reef rocks at the edge of the sea, waves breaking white around its base, the sun rising behind it over the Pacific, golden orange sky and silhouetted gate.
s:ibaraki/kashima-jingu: The inner approach of Kashima Jingu: a long straight gravel path through a dim ancient forest of towering cedar and broadleaf trees, a weathered wooden shrine hall glimpsed ahead, moss on stone lanterns, shafts of soft light through the canopy, quiet morning.
f:ibaraki/natto: A breakfast of Mito natto from 45 degrees: small sticky fermented soybeans in a small bowl with stringy threads lifted by chopsticks, topped with chopped green onion and a dab of mustard, a bowl of white rice and miso soup beside, a straw-wrapped natto bundle in the background, morning window light, shallow depth of field.
f:ibaraki/anko-nabe: Anko nabe at 45 degrees: a shallow earthenware pot of rich orange-brown monkfish-liver miso broth with pieces of white monkfish, skin, cabbage, shiitake, tofu, carrot and green onion, steam rising, tabletop burner, warm restaurant light, shallow depth of field.
f:ibaraki/hoshiimo: Flat strips of hoshiimo dried sweet potato on a small bamboo tray, translucent golden-amber flesh with a light white sugar bloom, a few slices fanned out, plain wooden table, soft natural winter light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
s:tochigi/nikko-toshogu: Yomeimon gate at Nikko Tosho-gu: an ornate two-storey gate densely covered in white-painted and gilded carvings, colourful painted figures, gold metal fittings and black lacquer beams under sweeping dark roofs, stone lanterns in the foreground, old cedar trees behind, soft overcast light.
s:tochigi/shinkyo: Shinkyo Bridge in late October: a vermilion lacquered wooden arch bridge spanning the fast rocky Daiya River, its stone piers below, steep banks covered in red, orange and yellow autumn foliage, cedar forest behind, soft morning light.
s:tochigi/kegon-falls: Kegon Falls in late October from the upper observation deck: a single tall plunge of white water dropping about 100 metres from a notch in a dark basalt cliff, smaller seeping waterfalls on the rock face, slopes covered in red and orange foliage, clear crisp autumn light.
s:tochigi/lake-chuzenji: Lake Chuzenji in mid-October: calm deep blue water reflecting slopes of red, orange and yellow autumn foliage along the shore, the cone of Mount Nantai rising behind, a small wooden pier, clear blue sky, soft morning light.
s:tochigi/kinugawa-onsen: Kinugawa Onsen from a suspension bridge: a deep rocky river gorge with emerald green water, large multi-storey hotel buildings lining the tops of both cliffs, lush green summer forest, a small wooden boat on the river, soft late-afternoon light.
s:tochigi/ashikaga-flower-park: The great wisteria trellis at Ashikaga Flower Park in late April: a vast single wisteria vine spread over a wide low trellis like a ceiling, thick curtains of pale purple blossoms hanging down, a gnarled trunk on supports, warm evening illumination against a dark blue sky.
s:tochigi/oya-history-museum: Inside the Oya History Museum: a vast underground quarry hall of pale grey-green Oya stone, towering rectangular pillars and straight-cut walls with chisel marks, dim cool air, soft spotlights casting deep shadows, small distant visitors on a walkway for scale.
s:tochigi/nasu-kogen: Nasu Highlands in mid-October: a wide slope of red, orange and yellow autumn shrubs below the barren grey volcanic summit of Mount Chausu with a wisp of steam, a ropeway car on its cable, clear blue sky, bright crisp light.
f:tochigi/utsunomiya-gyoza: A plate of Utsunomiya gyoza at 45 degrees: a neat row of pan-fried dumplings with crisp golden-brown bottoms and thin pale tops, a small dish of soy sauce, vinegar and chili oil beside, simple shop counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:tochigi/yuba: A Nikko yuba set from 45 degrees: thick rolls of fresh yellow-cream tofu skin in a light dashi broth in a small lacquer bowl, yuba sashimi with wasabi on a ceramic plate, rice and pickles on a wooden tray, soft natural window light, shallow depth of field.
f:tochigi/tochiotome: Glossy bright red Tochiotome strawberries piled in a small white bowl on a wooden table, a few with green caps and one cut in half showing pale pink flesh, bright natural winter window light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
s:gunma/kusatsu-yubatake: Yubatake in Kusatsu at night in winter: steaming hot spring water flowing down long rows of wooden channels into a turquoise and green mineral-crusted pool, a wooden railing around, illuminated by warm lights, snow on the surrounding wooden inn roofs.
s:gunma/sainokawara: Sainokawara open-air bath in winter, empty: a large rock-lined pool of steaming clear hot water in a forest clearing, snow piled on the rocks and surrounding trees, a wooden fence and simple roofed shelter at the side, gentle snowfall, soft grey light.
s:gunma/ikaho-onsen: The stone staircase of Ikaho Onsen in early autumn evening: a long flight of grey stone steps climbing uphill between old wooden inns, shops and lanterns, small distant visitors, warm lights coming on, faint mist, deep blue twilight.
s:gunma/tomioka-silk-mill: Tomioka Silk Mill: a long two-storey brick warehouse built in Flemish bond with a timber frame, an arched central entrance with a stone keystone and a dark tiled roof, a wide gravel courtyard in front, bright clear spring daylight, blue sky.
s:gunma/fukiware-falls: Fukiware Falls from the riverside rock terrace: a wide shallow river pouring sideways into a long narrow crack cut in the flat grey rock bed, white water foaming in the cleft, green and orange autumn foliage on the banks, soft overcast light.
s:gunma/tanigawadake: Mount Tanigawa in mid-October from the Tenjindaira area: rugged twin peaks with steep rocky faces above slopes covered in red, orange and yellow foliage, a ropeway line rising into the mountains, clear blue sky, crisp morning light.
s:gunma/oze-gahara: Ozegahara Marsh in late May: a long wooden plank boardwalk stretching across a flat wetland dotted with white skunk cabbage flowers by small streams, the snow-streaked Mount Shibutsu rising in the distance, soft morning light and light mist.
f:gunma/mizusawa-udon: Chilled Mizusawa udon on a bamboo zaru from 45 degrees: medium-thick, glossy, slightly translucent white noodles, a cup of sesame dipping sauce and a cup of soy dipping sauce beside, chopped green onion and grated ginger, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:gunma/yaki-manju: Gunma yaki manju on a bamboo skewer: four round steamed buns grilled over charcoal, glazed with sticky reddish-brown sweet miso sauce and slightly charred, on a paper plate, a charcoal grill glowing in the soft background, warm light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
f:gunma/onsen-manju: Small round brown onsen manju arranged in a wooden box, one broken open showing smooth sweet red bean paste, a cup of green tea beside, steam faintly rising, wooden table, soft natural light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
s:saitama/kawagoe-kurazukuri: Kawagoe Kurazukuri street on a clear autumn afternoon: a row of heavy two-storey merchant storehouses with thick black plaster walls, massive dark tiled roofs and onigawara ridge tiles, the tall wooden Toki-no-Kane bell tower rising behind, small distant pedestrians.
s:saitama/kawagoe-hikawa: Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine wind chime corridor in summer evening: rows of hundreds of glass Edo wind chimes with colourful paper strips hanging from a wooden frame, softly illuminated, a wooden shrine building behind, small distant visitors, warm blue-hour light.
s:saitama/hitsujiyama-park: Hitsujiyama Park in late April: rolling slopes covered in carpets of pink, magenta, purple and white moss phlox in curving patterns, Mount Buko rising beyond with its quarry-cut face, small distant visitors on paths, bright spring sunshine.
s:saitama/nagatoro: Nagatoro Iwadatami in mid-November: broad flat layered grey rock terraces along the emerald green Arakawa River, a long wooden boat with small distant passengers floating downstream, cliffs on the far bank with red and yellow autumn foliage, soft afternoon light.
s:saitama/chichibu-shrine: The main hall of Chichibu Shrine: a wooden shrine building with sweeping dark roofs, its walls and eaves covered in vividly painted carvings of tigers, dragons and owls in red, green, blue and gold, a stone-paved courtyard in front, soft daylight.
s:saitama/gongendo-park: Gongendo Sakura Embankment in early April: a long embankment lined with cherry trees in full pale pink bloom, a wide field of bright yellow rapeseed flowers along its base, small distant visitors on the path, clear blue sky, soft spring sunshine.
s:saitama/railway-museum: Inside the main hall of the Railway Museum: retired trains lined up on a wide indoor floor, a black steam locomotive on a turntable in the centre, a green and white bullet train and colourful express cars around it, high ceiling with steel trusses, soft even indoor light.
f:saitama/imo-sweets: Kawagoe sweet potato treats on a wooden bench: golden sweet potato chips in a paper cone, a purple-sweet-potato soft serve in a cone, and slices of yellow sweet potato yokan on a small plate, blurred old shopfront in the background, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:saitama/kawagoe-unagi: A lacquered box of Kawagoe unaju from 45 degrees: glossy caramel-brown grilled eel fillets glazed with sweet soy sauce laid over white rice, a small dish of sansho pepper and clear liver soup beside, tatami-room table, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:saitama/waraji-katsu: A Chichibu waraji katsudon at 45 degrees: a bowl of rice covered by two very large, thin, flat golden pork cutlets coated in dark sweet soy sauce, overhanging the rim, the lid set aside, pickles and miso soup beside, wooden table, warm light, shallow depth of field.
s:chiba/naritasan: Naritasan Shinsho-ji in late November: a vermilion three-storey pagoda with gilded and painted carvings beside the large Great Main Hall, wide stone steps leading up, maple trees in red and orange foliage in the foreground, clear afternoon light.
s:chiba/tokyo-disney-resort: A wide view across a theme park lagoon at dusk: a steaming volcano-shaped mountain of rugged red-brown rock rising behind a harbour of colourful Mediterranean-style buildings and an old sailing ship, warm lights reflecting on the water, purple and orange twilight sky, no visible logos or signs.
s:chiba/sawara: Sawara historic district on a quiet morning: the narrow Ono River lined with willow trees, old two-storey wooden merchant houses and dark storehouses with tiled roofs along both banks, a small flat-bottomed sightseeing boat on the calm water, soft spring light.
s:chiba/nokogiriyama: Jigoku Nozoki on Mount Nokogiri: a rocky ledge jutting out over a sheer quarried cliff face of tan stone, a railing along its edge, small distant visitors on it, green forested slopes below and Tokyo Bay stretching to the horizon, clear winter sky with faint Mount Fuji.
s:chiba/inubosaki: Inubosaki Lighthouse at sunrise: a tall white masonry lighthouse with a glass lantern room at its top standing on a rocky headland, the Pacific Ocean below with waves breaking over dark reef rocks, golden orange sun rising over the sea, clear sky.
s:chiba/yoro-keikoku: Awamata Falls in Yoro Valley in early December: a long gentle waterfall sliding down a broad smooth sloping rock face into a shallow pool, trees on both banks in red, orange and yellow late foliage, fallen leaves on the rocks, soft overcast light.
s:chiba/mother-farm: Mother Farm in late March: a wide hillside covered in bright yellow rapeseed flowers, a small flock of white sheep grazing on the green slope beside it, Tokyo Bay visible far below, clear blue spring sky, bright soft sunshine.
f:chiba/narita-unagi: An unadon from Narita at 45 degrees: glossy charcoal-grilled eel fillets lacquered with sweet soy sauce over rice in a deep ceramic bowl, a pinch of sansho pepper, a bowl of clear eel liver soup and pickles beside, wooden table, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:chiba/nure-senbei: Several Choshi nure senbei on a small plate: round flat rice crackers soaked in dark soy sauce, deep glossy brown, soft and slightly bent, one broken to show the moist interior, a cup of green tea beside, wooden table, natural light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
f:chiba/katsuura-tantanmen: A bowl of Katsuura tantanmen at 45 degrees: soy-sauce broth covered with a thick layer of red chili oil, noodles beneath, stir-fried chopped onion and minced pork on top, chopped green onion, steam rising, simple diner counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
s:tokyo/sensoji: Kaminarimon gate of Senso-ji in the early morning: a vermilion wooden gate with a dark tiled roof and a giant red paper lantern hanging in the centre, fierce guardian statues in side niches, the shop-lined Nakamise approach and five-storey pagoda behind, few small distant people, soft clear morning light.
s:tokyo/tokyo-skytree: Tokyo Skytree from a canal bridge nearby at blue hour: a slender pale blue-white steel lattice tower rising high above low city buildings, its observation decks ringed with light, its reflection on the calm canal water, low riverside trees in the foreground, deep blue twilight sky.
s:tokyo/ueno-park: The main avenue of Ueno Park in late March: a wide paved promenade lined on both sides with old cherry trees in full pale pink bloom forming a canopy overhead, petals drifting down, small distant visitors walking, soft bright spring daylight.
s:tokyo/tsukiji-outer-market: A narrow lane at Tsukiji Outer Market in the morning: crowded small food stalls under low awnings, trays of fresh seafood, grilled scallops on shells and rolled tamagoyaki on display, steam rising, small distant shoppers, soft overcast light, no readable signs.
s:tokyo/shinjuku-gyoen: Shinjuku Gyoen in early April: a wide green lawn edged with big cherry trees in full pale pink bloom, a calm pond in the foreground, the glass skyscrapers of Shinjuku rising beyond the trees, small distant picnickers, soft spring sunshine.
s:tokyo/tokyo-metropolitan-government: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building from the plaza below at dusk: twin grey granite towers with gridded window patterns, linked at the base and splitting into two tops above the 33rd floor, surrounding Shinjuku skyscrapers lit up, deep blue twilight sky.
s:tokyo/meiji-jingu: The approach to Meiji Jingu: a giant unpainted cypress-wood torii gate standing over a wide gravel path through a dense evergreen forest, tall trees on both sides, small distant visitors walking, soft filtered morning light.
s:tokyo/shibuya-crossing: Shibuya Scramble Crossing from an elevated vantage at night: crowds of small distant pedestrians crossing in every direction on the zebra-striped intersection, wet asphalt reflecting neon light, glowing buildings with large blank video screens, light rain, no readable text.
s:tokyo/odaiba: Rainbow Bridge from Odaiba Seaside Park at blue hour: a white suspension bridge with lit cables spanning Tokyo Bay, the city skyline and the red-and-white Tokyo Tower beyond, a sandy beach and calm water in the foreground with light reflections, deep blue sky.
s:tokyo/takao-san: Mount Takao in late November: a forested mountain trail climbing through maple trees in brilliant red, orange and yellow foliage, a stone-lined path and wooden railings, small distant hikers, soft filtered light; distant layered hills in the haze beyond.
f:tokyo/edomae-sushi: A set of Edomae nigiri on a wooden geta board at 45 degrees: glossy tuna, marbled fatty tuna, silver-skinned kohada, sweet shrimp, sea urchin and conger eel brushed with sweet sauce, pink pickled ginger and a dab of wasabi, white cypress counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:tokyo/monjayaki: Monjayaki on a teppan griddle at 45 degrees: a ring of chopped cabbage and seafood with runny batter bubbling in the centre, crisp browned edges, small metal spatulas resting on the griddle, warm restaurant light, light steam, shallow depth of field.
f:tokyo/tokyo-ramen: A bowl of Tokyo shoyu ramen at 45 degrees: clear brown chicken and soy broth with a light oil sheen, thin wavy noodles, a slice of chashu pork, menma bamboo shoots, a half boiled egg, nori sheet, naruto fish cake and chopped green onion, wooden counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:tokyo/tendon: A bowl of Asakusa tendon at 45 degrees: large crisp tempura shrimp and vegetables, kabocha, eggplant and shiso, glazed with dark sweet sauce over white rice, the lid set aside, miso soup and pickles beside, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:kanagawa/tsurugaoka-hachimangu: The Dankazura path to Tsurugaoka Hachimangu in early April: a raised straight walkway flanked by stone curbs and lined with cherry trees in full pale pink bloom, a large vermilion torii gate spanning it, small distant pedestrians, soft spring morning light.
s:kanagawa/kotoku-in: The Great Buddha of Kamakura: a seated bronze Amida Buddha about 11 metres high with a blue-green patina, eyes lowered and hands resting in meditation, sitting in the open air on a stone platform, trees behind, small distant visitors at the base, soft clear morning light.
s:kanagawa/hasedera: Hase-dera in June: a steep hillside path lined with thousands of blue, purple and pink hydrangea bushes in full bloom, the temple's tiled roofs below, and the blue curve of Yuigahama Bay beyond, soft overcast light.
s:kanagawa/enoshima: Enoshima from the beach on a clear winter afternoon: the green wooded island connected to the shore by a long bridge, a modern observation tower on its summit, calm blue sea, and the snow-capped cone of Mount Fuji rising faint on the horizon, soft golden light.
s:kanagawa/hakone-yumoto: Hakone-Yumoto in mid-November: a rocky green river running through a narrow valley, a small bridge across it, multi-storey ryokan and inns on the forested slopes on both sides, steam rising, red and orange autumn foliage, soft late-afternoon light.
s:kanagawa/hakone-open-air-museum: Hakone Open-Air Museum: large abstract and figurative sculptures arranged on rolling green lawns, a tall cylindrical tower clad in colourful stained glass, the forested Hakone mountains behind, clear summer sky, bright daylight.
s:kanagawa/owakudani: Owakudani volcanic valley on a clear day: barren yellow-grey slopes with white sulphur steam pouring from vents, a ropeway gondola passing overhead, and the snow-capped cone of Mount Fuji rising in the distance, crisp blue autumn sky.
s:kanagawa/minato-mirai: Minato Mirai 21 at blue hour from the harbour: the tall Landmark Tower, a curved sail-shaped hotel and the illuminated Cosmo Clock Ferris wheel reflected on calm water, a waterfront promenade and red brick warehouses at the side, deep blue twilight sky.
f:kanagawa/shirasu-don: Overhead view of a shirasu-don: a bowl of white rice heaped with tiny translucent raw whitebait on one half and fluffy white boiled shirasu on the other, grated ginger and shiso leaf in the centre, chopped green onion, a small soy sauce pitcher beside, wooden table, natural light.
f:kanagawa/kuro-tamago: Kuro tamago: several hard-boiled eggs with jet-black shells in a small paper bag, one cracked and peeled revealing glossy white egg, a pinch of salt beside, steam from volcanic vents faintly visible in the soft background, natural light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
f:kanagawa/iekei-ramen: A bowl of Yokohama iekei ramen at 45 degrees: rich creamy brown pork-bone and soy broth with a golden oil sheen, thick straight noodles, a slice of chashu, a heap of boiled spinach and three large nori sheets standing along the rim, a small bowl of rice beside, wooden counter, warm light.
f:kanagawa/hato-sable: Dove-shaped butter cookies from Kamakura: a few golden-yellow biscuits with lightly browned edges laid on a white plate, one broken to show the crumbly texture, a cup of tea beside, light wooden table, soft natural light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
